method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How a reed roof patch behaves when frozen thatch is bent during a windy thaw.
cases.circumstances: wet snow has crusted over a leaking eave
cases.situation: He must stop drips before night without tearing sound thatch.

cases.knowledge_need: How split birch billets dry differently when stacked above damp ground in spring rain.
cases.circumstances: freshly split wood must be stored beside melting snow
cases.situation: She needs fuel that will burn cleanly next cold season.

cases.knowledge_need: How a thick clay jug can crack when one side dries in direct afternoon sun while its base stays damp.
cases.circumstances: a shower has passed and clouds are breaking
cases.situation: He must dry the vessel evenly before firing.

cases.knowledge_need: How salt-stained wet iron tools corrode after river travel and what drying sequence limits further rust.
cases.circumstances: oars and tools were splashed during a rough crossing
cases.situation: He needs the axe and hooks ready by morning.

cases.knowledge_need: How warm weather and an unclean cloth affect fresh curds draining for soft cheese.
cases.circumstances: flies gather after a humid noon
cases.situation: She must keep the day's milk from becoming unsafe or wasted.

cases.knowledge_need: How a smoky fire that is too hot can cook fish rather than dry it and spoil a long keeping process.
cases.circumstances: wind has changed the draft through the vents
cases.situation: He must save a catch intended for later travel.

cases.knowledge_need: How heavy rain near a shallow well can change water clarity and contamination risk before household use.

cases.situation: Families need water for evening cooking.

cases.knowledge_need: How thin clear ice near a spring differs from thicker snow-covered ice on a slow stream.

cases.situation: He must lead sheep home without breaking through.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet leather traces stiffen overnight and alter a collar's fit on a working horse.

cases.situation: He must avoid rubbing the horse raw on the next journey.

cases.knowledge_need: How a sudden cold rain affects hens crowded in a poorly ventilated coop and their feed needs.

cases.situation: She must help them recover before night frost.

cases.knowledge_need: How a fox may approach scraps near a winter shed and what signs distinguish its tracks from a dog’s.

cases.situation: He must protect young animals without chasing blindly into dark.

cases.knowledge_need: How to recognize whether willow bark is usable for twisting when spring sap has begun to rise.

cases.situation: She needs flexible material for a repair basket.

cases.knowledge_need: How clear calm night conditions increase frost damage risk for young bean shoots compared with a cloudy night.

cases.situation: He must decide whether to cover tender plants before sunset.

cases.knowledge_need: How heat, sweating, and stale water affect a labourer who becomes dizzy while lifting hay.

cases.knowledge_need: How a small blister from damp socks can worsen during a long walk and which changes reduce rubbing.

cases.situation: She still has several hours to the next shelter.

cases.knowledge_need: How working beside a kiln in still summer air can produce dangerous heat exhaustion rather than ordinary tiredness.
cases.circumstances: he has been carrying fuel since sunrise
cases.situation: Others must spot warning signs before he collapses.

cases.knowledge_need: How low winter sun and reflected snow can hide a shallow ditch on a road.
cases.circumstances: the sun is behind him near late afternoon
cases.situation: He must keep a loaded cart from striking the edge.

cases.knowledge_need: How green alder wood changes flame, smoke, and heat when used to restart a nearly dead hearth.

cases.situation: He needs warmth without filling the shelter with smoke.

cases.knowledge_need: How rain-soaked hearth ash changes its usefulness for traction on ice and why hot embers must be excluded.

cases.knowledge_need: How a covered grain mash changes when a cool cellar suddenly warms and gas pressure builds beneath its lid.

cases.knowledge_need: How iron-rich water can shift a plant dye bath and leave uneven color on wool.

cases.knowledge_need: How a rope running over a rough wooden beam frays under a heavy suspended load.

cases.knowledge_need: How water in natural cracks and an overnight freeze can loosen a fieldstone unpredictably.

cases.knowledge_need: How a blocked ditch redirects rainwater under a path and creates a hidden muddy collapse at its edge.

cases.knowledge_need: How a cool breeze, shade, and flies affect whether freshly cut meat can be worked outdoors before salting.

cases.situation: He must choose a safer place and pace for processing.
